properties.name: document-query
properties.purpose: Query many (RFC-0013, principle 7): an llm.run node answers a question from the agent's knowledge graph - the schema first, then read-only openCypher through graph_query, in a read transaction inside the pack's configured database - and cites the source of every fact. No file is read: the documents were read once by document-ingest
The knowledge layer: the tool catalog the loop may use, and the error handler
The catalog: two rows copied from the agent tools' published catalog, both reads - no write mark, nothing waits
A run needs the 'question' field before any token is spent

mapping: text(Missing question. Ask the question in the 'question' field) -> output.body.message

input: text(You answer questions from the agent's knowledge graph and nothing else. Read the schema with graph_schema first, then run one or two read-only openCypher queries with graph_query, with every value as a parameter, and answer in plain sentences, citing the source property of every fact you use. If the graph holds nothing relevant, say so. Never read files or the web.) -> system
properties.purpose: The agent loop: the schema, one or two read-only queries, the answer with its sources - reads only, so nothing waits
The graph decides on the loop's status: an answer, or a stop
The model's answer with its sources, the call log and the usage

mapping: text(The model stopped without an answer. The status says why) -> output.body.message
properties.purpose: A refusal or a cap: the run ends and the caller learns why
The loop's own failure: a bad catalog, llm.chat or a tool route unreachable. It reports the error
